messages:
Alex: Quiet window starts in ~2h. Dropping a minimal checklist so we dont scatter. Keep updates here only.

Priya: Copy. Ill pin release notes in 10m and add the small migration note for SDK users.

Sam: Confirming pin intent: lock to v4.0.0 for 24h freeze?

Alex: Yes pin v4.0.0. Only SRE-Oncall + EngLead can approve emergency unpin.

Deploy Bot: deploy scheduled by @Alex  canary (9% traffic) at 2830010000 UTC. Status: scheduled.

SRE-Oncall: Preflight checklist (short):
- ensure no running schema migrations
- mute heavy crons (embeddings ingestion)
- run `/smoke canary --quick` at -20m
Ill run these and post results.

Maya: Heads up  embeddings ingestion cron at 01:15 overlaps the freeze and spikes worker autoscale. Recommend disabling it for 24h and set ingestion.concurrency=1.

Jordan: Rollback triggers for this window: error-rate > 1.0% sustained for 4m OR p95 > 1.6s for 6m => auto-rollback. Manual rollback on DB connection issues.

Priya: Release notes published: https://internal.redwood/releases/4.0.0  includes deprecations and a migration snippet for pagination.

Sam: `deploy-bot pin v4.0.0` executed. Pin shows locked; Sam + SRE-Oncall added as emergency unpin approvers.

SRE-Oncall: Quick rollback snippet for canary (ops):
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v3.9.8
deploy-bot unpin v4.0.0
kubectl rollout status deploy/api -n prod
```

Maya: Embeddings cron disabled and concurrency set to 1. Confirmed.

Deploy Bot: canary started -> 9% traffic. Monitoring: https://monitoring.redwood/canary/4.0.0

SRE-Oncall: Preflight smoke run -> PASS. No long queries or locks observed. Will re-run at +10m.

Alex: Ramp plan: canary stable at +15m -> 30% at +30m -> 60% at +60m -> full at +120m. Pause 10m between ramps for checks.

Priya: Added a short note in the notes asking small customers to postpone heavy writes until after freeze.

Jordan: On watch for SLO drift. Ping `@Jordan` in this thread for urgent attention.

Alex: GO for canary -> proceeding. If anything trips, page the paging channel and update here. Final quick status check at +2h.
